patches.old: Nine years later, RAIB records that more effective implementation of that recommendation
patches.new: RAIB now records that more effective implementation of that recommendation
patches.rationale: Removes a writer-computed elapsed interval the source never states, and which is wrong against the sentence's own 2016 anchor (Report 10/2026 was published ten years after that death). 'now' preserves the temporal contrast the sentence was carrying without asserting a figure.

patches.old: fewer than ten of them, none with a tram on the track — the silence had been true
patches.new: fewer than ten of them, and on none of them had they met a tram at the crossing — the silence had been true
patches.rationale: Restores the source's narrower claim. The source says they 'had never encountered a tram while crossing the tramway'; it does not establish that no tram was on the track during those circuits.
